title: The positioned layout draws circles as rectangles
foundBy: session agent, answering the repository owner's question whether a consuming page's protocol marks should be dots

evidence.verified: The browser test that draws a circle round fails on the parent commit and passes here. A circle with room for the mark size paints its centre and leaves the corners of its square unpainted. `npm run ci` passes on cc02010 with every gate run, and the visual gate passes 116 of 116 captures with no differing pixel; no existing capture holds a positioned circle.

resolution: In the positioned layout a `circle` or `hollow-circle` in a lane without bars draws round when its width reaches the mark size. Narrower, it stays a column.
details: In the positioned layout every shape draws as a rectangle of the mark's width, hollow or filled. A consuming page's legend shows the orchestrator's log claims as circles, to keep them apart from the channel's squares, and the timeline never drew a circle. A circle with room for the mark size should draw round; a hairline cannot.
